assessment: It has previously been suspected that secretion supports cell migration in human cells. This study proposes a physical model and offers various results that elegantly link the activation of a small GTPAse at the leading edge with the re-organisation of the secretory pathway, creating a feedback loop that allows persistence of direction. Hopefully, the simple physical model will serve as a foundation to include more regulatory loops in the conceptualisation of cell migration.
